name: Business
styleInstructions: Clear, polite, plain workplace English. Contractions are fine. Replace slang (gonna, wanna, yeah) with standard words. Short sentences, one idea each. Greeting 'Hi', not 'Hey'. Do not invent greetings, sign-offs or facts.

fewShot.in: hey john im gonna send the report eod yeah
fewShot.out: Hi John, I'm going to send the report EOD. Yes.
